# 1/0 — The Determination Returns

## #0 — What has been achieved

A determination returns with something to return: a statement made, a form recognised, a judgment acted upon. The `1` in `1/0` carries this achieved difference. It has come through questioning and assertion, withdrawal and extension, recurrence, personed context and the differential horizon of what it can say. Its exactness remains real when it turns toward what made that exactness possible.

The [eight-determination argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** this place in the whole traversal. The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the six determinations `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`; `1/0` turns their achieved articulation back toward its condition. It brackets the sixfold at its returning end. A seventh position inside that sixfold would turn the return into one more item to be counted, leaving the count's relation to its ground untouched.

## #1 — The same relation from its other end

`0` names the singular One which cannot be set beside its appearances as another appearance. `1` names the determinate face through which the All becomes locally articulate. That face already carries a world of relations: what it inherits, what it excludes, what makes it intelligible, what it changes. The [Mono–Poly manuscript](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones.md) **sources** this distinction between singular One and polyvalent All. Neither term names an isolated unit or a completed inventory.

In `0/1`, the relation is read as the condition becoming encounterable through determination. In `1/0`, the determination faces the condition through which it appears. The slash retains the relation while its orientation reverses. QL can therefore write their relational identity:

$$
0/1 = 1/0.
$$

The equality names one relation read from its two ends. Ordinary field arithmetic preserves a decisive difference: `0/1` evaluates to zero, while `1/0` is undefined. That seam belongs to the notation's work. The returning mark cannot supply a value which would place its unobjectifiable condition among the objects it has determined. The [Matheme record form](matheme/README.md) **qualifies** the formal descent by keeping native derivation, independent mathematical result and argued correspondence distinct.

## #2 — The limit encountered from within

The return becomes active when a determination tries to account for its own determining. I can describe my thought, attend to the feeling of being its owner, examine the instrument through which I know. Each examination yields something available to awareness. The awareness to which it is available has not thereby become identical with the examined content. Another description repeats that relation, however accurate the description becomes.

The [immutable-gap argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** this asymmetry. Its force concerns the condition of finding: every attempt to find the subject as an object already proceeds through the subject-position it seeks. `1/0` gives that turn its sign. The final determination `∞/dx` has already made local exactness answerable to an inexhaustible horizon; the return now reaches the one for whom the exact local account is given. The limit has become intimate to the act of knowing.

## #3 — Recognition changes the act

[Faithful definition](../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **embodies** this turn in a performed sequence. A definition is asserted, fails to contain its referent, succeeds in exposing that failure, and gathers the whole movement as its context. Even this gathered account can still speak about the subject as something over there. First-person recognition brings the one undertaking the definition into the relation the definition has been tracing. The speaking now proceeds from the presence it had been attempting to describe.

The [curated theorem spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **derives** the corresponding return of the three persons. First-, second- and third-person perspectives unfold sequentially; their isolation is voided, their unity recognised, and that one returns as `0/1`. The recognition has three operations while recognising one act, so the `3:3` reading also carries `3:1`. No extra observer must stand above the perspectives to unite them. What changes is their being lived and understood together.

## #4 — Difference carried through return

The [Symbolon root](README.md) **defines** `1/0` as the consequent essence and return vector: the achieved `5` is implicated in the `1` through this connection. The `1` which enters another relation carries what the completed passage has made available. The return has consequences because its prior differentiation survives. A remembered error, a revised judgment, a changed capacity to meet another person can condition what happens next.

[Compassion's vocation](../section-rooms/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **extends** this relation into conduct. Returning an account to someone's origins can change how they are treated; merely collecting their history can deepen possession. Loving sensitivity to origins requires those disclosed conditions to alter the account's use, its measure or its authority. This extension is Argued. The native return supplies its structure; the manner of an actual encounter must answer for itself.

The offered [planetary return](../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **tests** the same demand at the scale of institutions and technical systems. A consequential model must be capable of receiving a reply which changes the model, its governing measure or the institution using it. Provenance matters because someone can return through it and contest what was done. A complete record that changes nothing would leave that return unperformed.

## #5→0 — The work enters another life

[Draft 3](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) **sources** the terminal double devotion: to the whole, and to the particular form through which it arrives. The work must be sufficiently formed to be given. Its maker then releases the claim to govern every encounter it will enable. What returns through the work exceeds the maker's completed account while remaining answerable to the form and labour that made it possible.

This page **returns-to** [Integral Zero](../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), where the same sign carries the difference of the whole passage. The reader's next judgment, question or encounter gives the return its further life. `0/1` is available again with a determination retained, a history borne and a capacity changed. The zero has never become the returning one's possession.
